div.div:
Ingress: one shared ALB, created by the AWS Load Balancer Controller, routes by host — prod at eco.microtodosuite.online; dev, staging and demo at <env>.eco.microtodosuite.online.
Egress: private nodes reach the internet through the NAT gateway in their own AZ.
DNS: Route 53 is primary; Azure DNS serves the same records as secondary name servers.
